note: Regional park on the open prairie south of Oungre, built around a homesteader's grove planted in 1908 beside a creek, with a 9-hole golf course, 18-hole mini golf, an indoor pool in the Communiplex, ball diamonds and a volleyball court.  The campsites are on one loop east of the ball diamond; most are back-in (sites 14, 32 and 33 are pull-throughs).  Seasonal sites are let too. --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park, local). Rates C$28-40 confirmed; booking is RezExpert (operator, online). Electric 30, sewer, pull-through, laundry/flush/potable filled. Not waterfront kept (campsite loop ~130 m+ from a creek under 30 m wide). Pin moves ~305 m from the ball diamond to the campsite loop. Nightly share and season unverified.
flags: PIN: stored 49.16580,-103.80720 is on the ball diamond. Suggest 49.1650,-103.8032 (middle of the campsite loop east of the diamond and north of the Communiplex, Esri z17), about 305 m east. Google's point 49.16481,-103.80736 is at the Communiplex entrance.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. The creek (under 30 m wide) runs along the north edge of the park; the campsite loop's north end is about 130 m from it across open grass and a tree belt.

LONG-STAY (local): unmeasured. The park sells seasonal sites ('Seasonal Site: $1760.00 (includes one park sticker)') but posts no count of them; Esri imagery shows the loop packed with trailers in what looks like late spring, so seasonal sites may be a large share. Nightly rates are posted and the RezExpert booking page is live; no wording discouraging nightly guests. Saskatchewan Regional Parks' page for the park is 404. Reviewer may want the share: it would need the RezExpert availability view, which was not opened.
GOOGLE: 4.3 (71 reviews); the place also covers the golf course and pool, so the rating is not the campground's alone.
